title: Balance des Peintres
summary: Roger de Piles's 1708 numeric grading of the Old Masters, fed into the native HTML <meter> element so the browser vendor paints which painters are green and which are red.
mechanism: Native HTML <meter> elements (min/max/low/high/optimum) whose vendor-drawn green/yellow/red fill supplies the aesthetic verdict; zero JavaScript, no network.
references: Roger de Piles, Balance des Peintres / Cours de peinture par principes (1708)
